claims.claim: Israeli President Isaac Herzog will announce on Sunday, November 8, which party leader he will ask to try to form a government.
claims.episode_span: Israeli President Isaac Herzog will announce on Sunday, November 8, which party leader he will ask to try to form a government.
claims.source_title: Israel president to announce Sunday who will form new government
claims.supporting_quote: Israeli President Isaac Herzog said he will announce on Sunday, November 8, whom he will task with trying to form a new government, following post-election talks with all party leaders.

claims.claim: Forty-six parliament members recommended Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, while 67 backed his opponent Gadi Eisenkot.
claims.episode_span: Forty-six members of the 120-seat Knesset formally recommended Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for the mandate. Sixty-seven members recommended opposition figure Gadi Eisenkot instead.
claims.source_title: Israel president to announce Sunday who will form new government
claims.supporting_quote: 46 parliament members recommended Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, while 67 backed his opponent Gadi Eisenkot.

claims.claim: An Istanbul court placed former family minister Fatma Betul Sayan Kaya in custody on charges of violating capital markets law and membership of a criminal organisation.
claims.episode_span: An Istanbul court ordered former family minister and ruling Justice and Development Party deputy chair Fatma Betul Sayan Kaya into custody on charges of violating capital markets law and membership of a criminal organisation.
claims.source_title: Turkey: Ex-minister arrested in a major fund manipulation scandal
claims.supporting_quote: An Istanbul court remanded Fatma Betul Sayan Kaya in custody on charges of "violating the capital markets law and membership of an organization established for the purpose of committing crimes," state-run news agency Anadolu reported.

claims.claim: More than 430 people are under investigation over suspected market manipulation and insider trading, including 112 who have been arrested.
claims.episode_span: More than 430 people are now under investigation for suspected market manipulation and insider trading, and 112 of them have been arrested.
claims.source_title: Turkey: Ex-minister arrested in a major fund manipulation scandal
claims.supporting_quote: More than 430 people are under investigation over "suspected market manipulation and insider trading," including 112 who have been arrested as part of the scandal, Justice Minister Akın Gürlek said this week.

claims.claim: A Tanzanian court found opposition leader Freeman Mbowe guilty of incitement; the 58-year-old, detained since April last year, was acquitted of treason.
claims.episode_span: A Tanzanian court convicted opposition leader Freeman Mbowe of incitement. The 58-year-old politician, who has been detained since April of last year, was acquitted of the more serious charge of treason.
claims.source_title: Tanzanian opposition leader found guilty of incitement
claims.supporting_quote: The 58-year-old, who has been detained since April last year, was acquitted of the more serious charge of treason.

claims.claim: Deadly clashes in southern Ethiopia have driven tens of thousands of people into neighbouring Kenya; Ethiopia has around 130 million people.
claims.episode_span: Deadly clashes between armed groups in southern Ethiopia have driven tens of thousands of people across the border into neighbouring Kenya. Ethiopia, Africa’s second-most populous country with around 130 million people, is experiencing multiple armed conflicts.
claims.source_title: Ethiopia clashes drive thousands into Kenya
claims.supporting_quote: Ethiopia, Africa's second most populous country with around 130 million people, is grappling with multiple armed conflicts, particularly along borders between its states.

claims.claim: Chinese AI chipmakers Moore Threads, MetaX and Iluvatar CoreX recorded profits in the third quarter while facing US export controls on Nvidia processors.
claims.episode_span: Several Chinese pure-play artificial-intelligence chipmakers, including Moore Threads, MetaX and Iluvatar CoreX, recorded profits in the third quarter. The firms are expanding production to meet demand created by US export controls that restrict Nvidia’s high-end processors from reaching the Chinese market.
claims.source_title: China’s AI chipmakers report first profits, but will the trend continue?
claims.supporting_quote: Domestic graphics processing unit (GPU) developers including Moore Threads, MetaX and Iluvatar CoreX are racing to fill the market void left by Nvidia, whose high-end processors face strict US export controls.

claims.claim: Retail sales across the eurozone declined in September as high energy prices weighed on consumer confidence.
claims.episode_span: Retail sales across the eurozone declined in September. High energy prices continued to weigh on consumer confidence and spending.
claims.source_title: Eurozone Retail Sales Slumped in September
claims.supporting_quote: Retail sales fell in as high energy prices continued to weigh on consumer confidence.

claims.claim: The United States sanctioned a Cambodia-based transnational criminal organisation accused of running online scam operations that have victimised hundreds of Kenyans.
claims.episode_span: The United States imposed fresh sanctions on a Cambodia-based transnational criminal organisation accused of running international online scam operations. Hundreds of Kenyans who were rescued from scam centres in Southeast Asia have been identified as victims of the expanding networks.
claims.source_title: Kenya: U.S. Sanctions Cambodia-Based Scam Network Linked to Trafficking of Kenyans Into Forced Labour
claims.supporting_quote: The United States has imposed fresh sanctions on a Cambodia-based transnational criminal organisation accused of running international online scam operations, as hundreds of Kenyans rescued from scam centres in Southeast Asia emerge as victims of the expanding criminal networks.
